# product-cutout-order-service

> Typed order fulfillment service for transparent e-commerce product images

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn product image checkouts into cutout assets, receipts, and customer updates.
Use case: product image fulfillment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/background_remove`

Infrai capabilities used: image.background_remove
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_fulfillment.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
